newsitem.title: USA: CBS edges NBC again in weekly Nielsen ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBS edges NBC again in weekly Nielsen ratings.

text.p: Television network CBS beat competitor NBC by one-tenth of rating point for the second week in a row, even though NBC had the week's five highest-rated shows, Nielsen Media Research said on Tuesday.
For the week ending May 18, Westinghouse Electric Corp unit CBS had a 10.9 rating, while NBC, owned by General Electric Co, posted a 10.8.

That translated to a 19 percent share for CBS and an 18 percent share for NBC. Walt Disney Co's ABC was third with an 8.2 rating and a 14 share, while News Corp Ltd's Fox was fourth with a 7.2 rating and a 12 share.

NBC had the five highest-rated shows, led by "E.R." and "Seinfeld." The top-rated CBS shows were "CBS Wednesday Night Movie," "Touched by an Angel" and "CBS Tuesday Night Movie," which ranked sixth, seventh and eighth, respectively.
Trailing the other networks in the overall ratings were Viacom Inc's UPN with a 2.8 rating and a five share, and Time Warner Inc's WB with a 2.5 rating and a four share.
Rating points are a measurement of the percentage of the 97 million U.S. households with television sets.
Nielsen is a unit of Cognizant Corp.
